def factor_volume_price_beta_centered(df):
    """Centered rolling beta of return on log volume change using rolling covariance and variance."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret_1 = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_log = np.log(df_copy["volume"].replace(0, np.nan))
    vol_diff = vol_log.diff()
    cov = ret_1.rolling(20, min_periods=5).cov(vol_diff)
    var = vol_diff.rolling(20, min_periods=5).var()
    beta = cov / var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    beta = beta.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta_centered"] = beta
    return df_copy["factor_volume_price_beta_centered"]
description: Mutation of parent volume-price beta. The parent uses ratio of rolling means without centering, which can be biased when log volume changes have a nonzero rolling mean (trend). This child uses pandas trailing rolling covariance and rolling variance to compute a standard centered OLS beta, isolating unexpected volume change. Preserves the core economic mechanism: positive beta indicates informed flow backing price changes, negative beta signals divergence. Same 20-day window and min_periods=5 to preserve RankIC/RankICIR and payoff profile. No cross-sectional transform because parent evidence supports the raw mechanism.
